description: The figure presents a comparison of clustering results from two models, "AttentionInfluence" on the left and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" on the right, both visualized as radial bar charts. The "AttentionInfluence" chart shows a total of 12 primary categories, with "Education" being the largest at 25, followed by "Teaching & resources" at 15, "Science & technology education" at 10, "Health & Medicine" at 22, "Diseases" at 11, "Science" at 15, "Animal & Plant" at 13, "Nutrition" at 5, "Medical" at 6, "Historical review" at 7, "Society & culture" at 10, and "Events & people" at 6. These categories are further subdivided into smaller segments, such as "Tech & Engineer" (12), "Infor tech" (5), "Materials" (3), "Emerging tech" (4), "Manage" (2), and "Policy" (1), which are labeled with their respective values and connected by lines to their positions on the chart. The "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" chart displays 10 primary categories, with "Education" being the largest at 38, followed by "Teaching & resources" at 17, "Science & technology education" at 19, "Health & Medicine" at 19, "Diseases" at 10, "Nutrition" at 7, "Medical" at 2, "Animal & Plant" at 12, "Science" at 15, and "Historical review" at 12. This chart also includes smaller segments such as "Society & culture" (5), "Events & people" (2), "Infor tech" (3), "Materials" (1), "Emerging tech" (4), "Tech & Engineer" (8), and "Manage" (1), each labeled with its value and connected to its position on the chart. Both charts use distinct colors for each category and segment, and the labels are clearly visible, providing a detailed breakdown of the clustering statistics for each model.
